card.name: Silver lining and bright side phrases
card.fires_on: Words in idioms that introduce a positive point, such as 'silver lining', 'bright side', 'on the plus side' and 'on the flip side'. It fires on the lining, side, bright or flip word, usually after a negative statement.

modes.label: Silver lining
modes.description: The word lining, or a nearby word, in 'one silver lining' that introduces a upside.
modes.example: If there’s one silver<< lining>> to seeing the preclearance provision invalidated

modes.label: Bright or plus side
modes.description: The word side or bright in 'bright side' or 'on the plus side' before a positive point.
modes.example: On the plus<< side>>, 85 percent did say customers

modes.label: Flip side
modes.description: The word flip in 'on the flip side', which introduces a contrasting point.
modes.example: “But on the<< flip>> side, women have less muscle mass and
